scope: Read-only retrospective over a fixed 27-record Phase 5 snapshot; parent writes only coverage and its own evidence.

coverage.title: 5.2 [prim-create-card] primitive createCard (cards: type and subtype synergies) (core-review)
coverage.finding: Creation form and redacted source event landed. The existing-card brief confusion cost 15 minutes; current UUID authority and the 440 disposition cover it. Both core-review test findings landed in 434. Two edit-induced sweep transport failures retain their evidence; source freeze is current policy.

coverage.title: 5.2 [prim-play-restriction] primitive playRestriction (cards: remaining unique cards) (core-review)
coverage.finding: The UUID and printed-text briefing mismatch was dispositioned in 440. An API interruption cost 20 minutes and required fuzz and sweep reruns. An additive comment conflict was recovered. All three core-review findings landed in 439; its comment follow-up 444 is already canonical.

coverage.title: 5.2 [prim-take-extra-turn] primitive takeExtraTurn (cards: remaining unique cards) (core-review)
coverage.finding: Extra turns reuse the settled C8 scheduling rules. The 300-game fuzz passed; 106.67 seconds wrapper versus 69.2 seconds worker includes unseparated heavy wait. Two geometry and fixture assumptions were corrected without a source defect. Quota review exit 1 was later cleared by actual other-family exit 0 in 158.647 seconds. Its description finding landed in 437.

coverage.title: 5.2 [cards-09] cards: card flow (9/97)
coverage.finding: Five-card composition adds two D20 scenarios and changes no engine code. Weighted 300-game fuzz passed. The sweep has 100 effective cells: 52 passes and 48 skips. One initial deadline failed and its one documented fresh retry passed. Exercise counts certify card plays, not activations or clauses. The 26.9-millisecond pre-command interval is a queue and startup upper bound.

coverage.title: Capture materialized card identities for deferred effects (core-review)
coverage.finding: Three core-review rounds repaired hidden cohort omission, source leakage, saved-state validation, aliasing and variant fidelity. The record attributes 80 minutes to review repair. Persistent status loss remains canonical 436. The configured Beads outage and 435 recovery notes describe the same incident.

coverage.title: Show live static void-play permissions in battle badges
coverage.finding: Static-permission contracts and the actual God workflow pass. A chooser assumption and recapture after materialization retain their evidence. Cold mobile review found a real 6-pixel status badge and hand overlap, assigned to active 443. Empty caps does not clear that visual failure. Core review remained pending in frozen notes.

coverage.title: Ability chooser names each ability and places its heading with the options
coverage.finding: The authored ability chooser passed both viewports with resource, replay and UUID log proof. Two harness failures were corrected using settled presentation and canonical caps checks. Two overlapping review and Knip pairs are retained; final checks ran sequentially before accepted frozen QA.

coverage.title: The QA battle driver recognizes auto-answered prompts
coverage.finding: The shared auto-answer helper passed both rendered and automatic branches. After an immediate step commit, the event carries no forced answer and the public helper may return a null answer. One 10-minute observation does not establish a recurring new cost.

coverage.title: One shared helper exports a game persisted log in QA scenarios
coverage.finding: Shared persisted-log export was verified on successful runs, throws before and after game creation, and the declared stage branch. The UUID logs are retained. FIFO work uses this stable helper.

coverage.title: Materialize from a filtered or whole deck re-checks deck knowledge
coverage.finding: Typed deck-knowledge negative proofs, a 50-game smoke and exact cold privacy review are settled. Shared proof and asymmetric-view findings landed in 432. The reproduced sibling banishment leak landed in 433. Review debt is cleared.

coverage.title: Views keep cost effects whose source the viewer cannot see
coverage.finding: Eight unchanged-source hidden-cost negatives were repaired while preserving source redaction. Focused view and determinization checks, review and Knip passed. No additional friction was recorded.

coverage.title: Greedy simulates an accepted loop within its think budget
coverage.finding: The bounded Greedy loop simulation retains the original engine action and uses a catalog tunable. Setup and type mistakes were corrected. Final focused checks, review, Knip and 20 Random games passed. This smoke is not Greedy-loop fuzz, and no strict wall-time guarantee is claimed.

coverage.title: Loop recordings note which prompts the actor fully saw, so samples can replay them
coverage.finding: Fully visible prompt metadata repairs loop sampling. The 200-game run completed 99,885 steps with zero failures. Worker wall 68.8 seconds and wrapper wall 69.534 seconds were measured under load. They do not establish a low-load regression.

coverage.title: Phase 5 retrospective (since hv-umm2.402)
coverage.finding: The baseline retrospective record is uncovered and belongs in this covers list. Its six improvements 426–431 are closed. The original 25 covered IDs are excluded from this new list.

coverage.title: Floating-change kinds register through a typed table
coverage.finding: The typed validator table makes an omitted required member produce TS2741. All 28 public intake rows are byte-identical before and after. No tests, browser workflow or fuzz case was added. Subsequent 109 registered its kinds, with no validator omission found.

coverage.title: Review validates changed friction records; measurement corrections ride the next bead
coverage.finding: Changed friction records are schema-validated in review and the gate. Measurement corrections use the next ordinary bead. The frozen trigger report preserves 41 audited unknown observations. Three release schema checks took 0.1–0.2 seconds.

coverage.title: The browser lease serves waiters in order and the sweep yields it between cards
coverage.finding: FIFO arrival tickets, card-boundary yielding and separate wait and execution reports are verified by bounded contracts and the real two-acquirer check. Old worktree participants retain exclusion but can bypass tickets. The 121 sweep had no queued waiter and zero yields, so it does not establish improved fairness under contention.

coverage.title: Cost-modifier composition contracts every new modifier must join
coverage.finding: All 314 typed cost-composition rows pass settled rulings. The current recipe requires a new cost mode, route or extension to join the table. No later modifier primitive in this freeze establishes a reduction in future review churn.

coverage.title: Inventory capability probes read exported forms, not source regexes
coverage.finding: Export and form descriptors replace regex capability guesses. Representative resolver proof missed C12 meaning and complete table coverage; accepted repairs landed in 435. CLI timings alone do not establish causal speed improvement or complete correctness.

coverage.title: Bead notes and friction records stay readable
coverage.finding: Compact seven-field records and spaced-note guidance are current. Later records 435, 439 and 440 follow the compact shape. Some transition prose remains dense. Reading-time reduction is unmeasured.

coverage.title: Share public ability proof and cover asymmetric deck knowledge
coverage.finding: Shared public-ability proof and exactly-one-viewer contracts close the accepted 409 findings. Mutation controls discriminate incorrect visibility. The bounded 62-line non-test change does not require another cold review under the current policy.

coverage.title: Settle deck knowledge while banishing named deck references
coverage.finding: Twelve failing unchanged-base banishment cases and unordered and asymmetric mutations close the reproduced sibling leak from 409. The 100-game smoke has zero failures. Persistent hidden-zone status loss remains separate in 436.

coverage.title: createCard review: pin the production Seer of the Fallen trigger and a duplicate intent
coverage.finding: Production Seer base and amplified clauses and duplicate-intent contracts close the 108 findings. An additive registry conflict was recovered through the native checkpoint and update protocol. Final checks are meaningful and settled. The 72.56-minute elapsed window includes interruption and is not isolated repair time.

coverage.title: Keep C12 remapping pending and contract every inventory descriptor
coverage.finding: Independent fixtures cover 47 descriptors and 48 forms, and preserve intended pending C12 semantics. The 54.7-minute interruption interval includes paused observation. The lost mutant observer was reconciled and intended source restored. Core review found a pending-marker lifecycle defect already assigned to 441.

coverage.title: Extra-turn review: describe the present-status fixture turn sequence
coverage.finding: The present-status fixture description closes the 112 finding. The edit is in an executable fixture module and selects a broad gate. Its 100.645-second gate does not belong in the evidence-only comparison.

coverage.title: playRestriction review: announce the chosen card even when the restriction cannot start; test every play route and real zone moves
coverage.finding: A real chosen-card announcement negative was repaired using the existing reveal event before duration resolution. Focused contracts cover 1,019 cases, four routes and real moves. Both viewports pass normal QA. Two harness predicate failures are retained. Exact cold review took 88.429 seconds and found only comments, assigned to 444.

coverage.title: Audit and disposition the plan brief mismatch trigger
coverage.finding: Three historical briefing causes receive one evidenced reason disposition. Current guidance and runtime source remain unchanged. Evidence-only review took 0.320 seconds and sequential Knip took 5.283 seconds. The failed scratch parser is not a focused test. Exact promotion, cleanup and runtime closure are settled.

improvementsSince425.429: The settled composition table and future recipe obligation are established. Subsequent cost primitives have not exercised its churn-prevention claim in this freeze.

waitingAndFailures.browserLease: Recorded waits include 108 sweep 59.6 seconds, 112 initial flow 39.683 seconds, 399 settled desktop 70.864 seconds and 393 baseline 30.693 seconds. The 121 sweep waited 43 milliseconds; final 439 waited 50 milliseconds. These workloads had different content, loads, old and new participants, and demand. They do not form a comparative FIFO benchmark.
waitingAndFailures.heavySlot: The 112 wrapper took 106.671 seconds and the worker took 69.2 seconds; the difference includes unseparated lock and startup overhead. The 121 pre-command interval of 26.908 milliseconds bounds queue plus startup. Total exact heavy waiting is unknown.
waitingAndFailures.reviewQuota: The 112 unavailable attempt exited 1 before reading source and was later cleared by an actual other-family review. The 392 checkpoint mentions a usage limit. Total blocked lane time was not recorded; asynchronous review policy permits continued work.
waitingAndFailures.prerequisites: Graph serialization and native claiming are intentional. Dispatch and close timestamps do not distinguish active implementation, unattended waiting and shared-duty preemption. The 15 percent idle-lane measurement is unknown.
waitingAndFailures.mergeConflicts: The 109 and 434 additive comment and spec registry conflicts were recovered through the current same-worktree protocol. Conflicts are not red CI. No new blanket serialization edge is warranted.
waitingAndFailures.BeadsOutage: The 392 notes record 14:33–15:27 and the 435 notes record recovery of the same configured-server outage. This is one observed incident across two sessions. Current restart guidance applies; no recurring server defect is established.
waitingAndFailures.interruptions: An API limit interrupted the 109 sweep and lost its first fuzz observer. User continuation affected command observers in 434 and 435. The 54.7-minute interval in 435 includes interrupted observation; it is not isolated mutation repair time. Existing re-entry, source restoration and runtime protocols handled recovery.
waitingAndFailures.qaFailures: The retained failures include two edit-induced transport errors in 108, two geometry or fixture premises in 112, presentation and caps assumptions in 399, chooser and materialization assumptions in 393, two predicates in 439, and one documented fresh deadline retry in 121. Shared readiness helpers, source freeze and the one-retry policy cover the tooling causes. Empty caps does not clear the 393 visual failure.
waitingAndFailures.fuzz: All settled frozen fuzz and smoke runs reported zero failures. Weighted card exercise counters certify card plays; they do not certify every activation, clause or variant.
waitingAndFailures.reviews: Accepted follow-ups: 409 to 432 and 433; 108 to 434; 112 to 437; 109 to 439; 430 to 435; 435 to 441; 392 persistent status to 436; 439 comments to 444. The 393 review remained pending in frozen notes. No blanket all-reviews-cleared claim is made.

budgetRecommendation.reason: All source/test/fixture gates have median 54.3095 seconds and the engine/content subset has median 60.611 seconds. They are mixed scopes at unknown gate load. Three full-test samples took 48.9–53.6 seconds at load 14.21–21.98, below 60 seconds; the required Phase 5 low-load two-worker measurement remains pending. Local review selections and smoke sizes differ from one-file and 200-game baselines. No evidence supports a budget relaxation or causal speed improvement of 10 percent.

sageAudit.epicSummary: Retrospective 442 covers all 27 frozen records since 425, including the record for 425; the future record for 442 is excluded. All 27 promoted gates have passing sealed evidence; source/test/fixture median 54.3095 seconds and engine/content median 60.611 seconds. The 22 frozen passed release buildsets have median 143.167 seconds. Three retained full-test runs took 48.9–53.6 seconds at load 14.21–21.98; the low-load phase-gate reading remains pending. Keep budgets. Improvements 426–431 are landed; existing 436, 441, 443 and 444 own the remaining status, marker, renderer and prose findings. No distinct uncovered recurring cause or new improvement bead was found; all fired triggers have dispositions. Unknown queue, idle and quota waits and the frozen pending 393 review are preserved.
